content.short: Ambient Finance is a zero-to-one DEX protocol that runs within a single smart contract to maximize gas efficiency.
content.description: Ambient Finance is a decentralized exchange protocol that operates entirely within a single smart contract, significantly reducing gas costs and liquidity fragmentation. It uniquely combines "ambient" (constant-product) and "concentrated" liquidity in a single pool, offering a more efficient trading experience. The protocol features "Knockout Liquidity," a specialized limit order tool that prevents orders from reversing once a target price is hit. Ambient also supports automated fee reinvestment and gasless transactions, providing a professional-grade experience for all DeFi traders.
